paragraphs: R. Yaakov ben Dosai walked three mil through honey up to his shoulder. (See R. Akiva ben Dosa.) Ketubbot (111, end of side b). In the Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of the chapter Aḥad Dinei Mamonot: Dasai. In the first chapter of Makkot, halakhah 15 as printed (the corresponding passage is 1:7:2): bar Dasi. In chapter Kelal Gadol: bar Dasai. The rabbis of Caesarea said: R. Yaakov bar Dasai asked, Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot, end of chapter 11.
